what: A pasted standing approval already covering queued work was still held for a second confirmation round trip, only because an unrelated policy change arrived bundled in the same message.
rule: Work already recorded and queued is pre-approved and can start right away; a fresh typed confirmation is needed only for genuinely new requests, secrets, credentials, material meant for publication, or anything that spends money.
fix: Enforcement: the coordination guide and the onboarding instructions both now state this rule at the point work begins. Regression coverage is in `tests/kickoff.test.mjs`.
